fact: Article 12 of Ordonnance-loi n°23/010 of 13 March 2023 gives the Conseil National du Numérique, created by art. 11, the mission to watch over the ethics of advanced digital technology and notably artificial intelligence.
title: Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 du 13 mars 2023 portant Code du numérique
publisher: République démocratique du Congo (Présidence de la République)
why_not: The fetched body is transliterated (no accents), so it cannot be handed over; parent 2026-10-20.
